extName.description: Extension name shown in the toolbar and chrome://extensions

extDescription.message: Pin enterprise SSO sign-in to a specific Google account, skipping the account chooser when several accounts are signed in.

appTitle.description: Main heading of the options page

lede.message: During enterprise SSO, point the authorization request at a specific Google account so you skip the “choose an account” and “enter your email” steps.

emailHint.message: The account to pin on sign-in. It is sent as `login_hint` on the authorization request.

domainsHint.message: One per line; commas or spaces also work. Used to recognize your company's sign-in flow — *only requests whose URL contains one of these domains are modified*, so signing in with a personal account elsewhere is unaffected.

authuserHint.message: Only needed when `login_hint` alone does not select the account. The value is the N in the Gmail address bar path `/mail/u/N/`. Note that it changes with sign-in order.

accountsIntro.message: Always open certain sites with a specific Google account — Meet, Calendar and Docs on your work account, for example, while everything else stays on your personal one. This adds `authuser` and is independent of Enterprise SSO above; *either one works on its own*.

accountsEmpty.message: No bindings yet. Use the button below to add one.

backupHint.message: Export your settings to a JSON file so you can import them again after reinstalling or switching machines. The file contains your work email and domain list — do not share it casually.

diagnosticsHint.message: If sign-in does not seem to be using your rules, check which of them matched in the last 5 minutes. This needs one extra permission, used only to read this extension's own rule matches. Nothing is uploaded, and you can revoke it at any time from the extension's details page.

statusIncomplete.message: Nothing configured yet — set up Enterprise SSO, or add an account binding

statusSsoPartial.message: Enterprise SSO needs both an email address and at least one domain; filling in only one produces no rules

statusNotGranted.message: Access to those domains was not granted, so the rules cannot take effect

diagNotGranted.message: Not granted, so rule matches cannot be read

diagNoMatches.message: No matches in the last 5 minutes — sign in once, then come back

backupImported.message: Loaded — click “Save and grant access” to apply

importErrNotObject.message: File content is not a settings object

importErrWrongFormat.message: Not a settings file exported by this extension

importErrMissingFields.message: The file is missing the email address or company domains
